title: Slider
description: The pulseaudio slider module displays and controls the current volume of the default sink or source as a bar.

min.label: Min
min.doc: The minimum volume value the slider should display and set.
min.description: The minimum volume value the slider should display and set.

max.label: Max
max.doc: The maximum volume value the slider should display and set.
max.description: The maximum volume value the slider should display and set.

target.label: Target
target.doc: Whether the slider will control the default audio source or default audio sink. Valid values are either "sink" or "source".
target.description: Whether the slider will control the default audio source or default audio sink. Valid values are either "sink" or "source".

orientation.label: Orientation
orientation.doc: The orientation of the slider. Can be either horizontal or vertical.
orientation.description: The orientation of the slider. Can be either horizontal or vertical.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

zero-on-mute.label: Zero on mute
zero-on-mute.doc: true = The slider will be set to min when the source/sink is muted. false = The slider will continue to show the unmuted volume level when the source/sink is muted.
zero-on-mute.description: true = The slider will be set to min when the source/sink is muted. false = The slider will continue to show the unmuted volume level when the source/sink is muted.

unmute-on-volume-change.label: Unmute on volume change
unmute-on-volume-change.doc: Specifies whether to unmute a muted souce/sink when its volume is changed by the user moving the slider.
unmute-on-volume-change.description: Specifies whether to unmute a muted souce/sink when its volume is changed by the user moving the slider.

ignored-sinks.label: Ignored sinks
ignored-sinks.doc: A list of sink descriptions to ignore when tracking the default sink, so switching to those sinks does not update the slider.
ignored-sinks.description: A list of sink descriptions to ignore when tracking the default sink, so switching to those sinks does not update the slider.

sink-mapping.label: Sink mapping
sink-mapping.doc: Sinks named by the values of this mapping will be considered to be the current sink instead of the sinks named by the respective keys.
sink-mapping.description: Sinks named by the values of this mapping will be considered to be the current sink instead of the sinks named by the respective keys.
